title: Freeze a merged review as reachable read-only history
preconditions: A reviewed pull request can be merged and repinned to its landed commit.

steps.action: Record the landed merge and open the historical review.
steps.expected_result: The original base, reviewed head, landed commit, deck, decisions, comments, and coverage remain viewable.

steps.action: Attempt a new decision on the frozen review and inspect Documentation pages.
steps.expected_result: The historical review rejects the write and Documentation still offers no approval or comment controls.

steps.action: Open history from documentation changed by the review.
steps.expected_result: The merged review remains reachable without becoming current product truth.

expected_result: Pass when merge freezes the review and history links remain readable while all later review writes are refused; fail if frozen evidence changes or Documentation gains decision controls.
